title: Специальные вопросы
description: Составь специальный вопрос: выбери вопросительное слово и вспомогательный глагол (лексика Lifestyles)

items.statement: Your friend goes to the sports club after school.
items.hint: Когда твой друг ходит в спортивный клуб?
items.answer: When does your friend go to the sports club?

items.statement: Teenagers use social media every day.
items.answer: How often do teenagers use social media?

items.statement: Your sister watches TV in the evening.
items.answer: When does your sister watch TV?

items.statement: You have English lessons twice a week.
items.hint: Как часто у тебя уроки английского?
items.answer: How often do you have English lessons?

items.statement: Your teacher gives you tests on Fridays.
items.answer: When does your teacher give you tests?

items.statement: Your parents work in a modern office.
You do your homework in your bedroom.
items.answer: Where do you do your homework?

items.statement: Your classmates play computer games at the weekend.
items.hint: Когда одноклассники играют в компьютерные игры?
items.answer: When do your classmates play computer games?

items.statement: Your cousin lives in a big city.
You visit your grandparents every month.
items.hint: Как часто ты навещаешь бабушку с дедушкой?
items.answer: How often do you visit your grandparents?

items.statement: He studies for his exams in the library.
items.answer: Where does he study for his exams?

items.statement: They go to the cinema on Saturdays.
items.answer: When do they go to the cinema?

items.statement: Your brother plays the guitar very well.
items.hint: Что твой брат играет очень хорошо?
items.answer: What does your brother play very well?
What do you read about music?

items.statement: Your family has dinner together in the evening.
items.answer: When does your family have dinner together?

items.statement: Your mum cooks healthy meals for dinner.
items.answer: What does your mum cook for dinner?
